result.evidence_quote: To identify plasma protein differences between type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) patients with and without metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), and to evaluate the diagnostic potential of X-prolyl aminopeptidase 3 (XPNPEP3) for identifying MASLD in T2DM patients.
result.rationale: The study evaluates a diagnostic biomarker for MASLD in patients with diabetes. It does not address cancer biology, tumor progression, tumor biomarkers, or cancer treatments.
